verses.en: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.zh: 起初，神创造天地。

words.n: b'reshit — 'in a beginning'. b- ('in') fused onto reshit ('head, first'). The Bible opens not with a sentence but with a prepositional phrase.
bara elohim — 'created God', i.e. 'God created'. Hebrew puts the verb first; the subject follows it. You'll meet this order in nearly every narrative sentence.

verses.en: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
verses.zh: 地是空虚混沌，渊面黑暗；神的灵运行在水面上。

words.n: tohu va-vohu — 'wild and waste'. A rhyming pair, the kind of doubling Hebrew uses where English would reach for an adjective.

verses.en: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
verses.zh: 神说：「要有光」，就有了光。

words.n: va-yomer — 'and he said'. The same vay- chain that drives Jonah: va- + verb, one step forward in the story.
y'hi or — 'let there be light'. Two words. y'hi is hayah in the jussive: a third-person command or wish.

verses.en: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.zh: 神看光是好的，就把光暗分开了。

words.n: va-yavdel bein … u-vein — 'he separated between X and between Y'. Hebrew repeats bein before each item; English says 'between' once.

verses.en: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
verses.zh: 神称光为「昼」，称暗为「夜」。有晚上，有早晨，这是头一日。

words.n: va-yiqra … yom — 'he called the light day'. qara + l- means 'to call something by a name'.
yom echad — 'day one', not 'first day'. The other days take ordinals (sheni, sh'lishi); day one keeps the cardinal.

verses.en: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
verses.zh: 神说：「诸水之间要有空气，将水分为上下。」

verses.en: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
verses.zh: 神就造出空气，将空气以下的水、空气以上的水分开了。事就这样成了。

verses.en: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
verses.zh: 神称空气为「天」。有晚上，有早晨，是第二日。

verses.en: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
verses.zh: 神说：「天下的水要聚在一处，使旱地露出来。」事就这样成了。

verses.en: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
verses.zh: 神称旱地为「地」，称水的聚处为「海」。神看着是好的。

words.g: and + to + something waited for, i.e. confidence

verses.en: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.
verses.zh: 神说：「地要发生青草和结种子的菜蔬，并结果子的树木，各从其类，果子都包着核。」事就这样成了。

verses.en: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.zh: 于是地发生了青草和结种子的菜蔬，各从其类；并结果子的树木，各从其类；果子都包着核。神看着是好的。

verses.en: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
verses.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第三日。

verses.en: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
verses.zh: 神说：「天上要有光体，可以分昼夜，作记号，定节令、日子、年岁，

verses.en: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.
verses.zh: 并要发光在天空，普照在地上。」事就这样成了。

verses.en: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
verses.zh: 于是神造了两个大光，大的管昼，小的管夜，又造众星，

verses.en: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
verses.zh: 就把这些光摆列在天空，普照在地上，

verses.en: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
verses.zh: 管理昼夜，分别明暗。神看着是好的。

verses.en: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
verses.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第四日。

verses.en: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
verses.zh: 神说：「水要多多滋生有生命的物；要有雀鸟飞在地面以上，天空之中。」

verses.en: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
verses.zh: 神就造出大鱼和水中所滋生各样有生命的动物，各从其类；又造出各样飞鸟，各从其类。神看着是好的。

words.g: the + a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal

verses.en: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
verses.zh: 神就赐福给这一切，说：「滋生繁多，充满海中的水；雀鸟也要多生在地上。」

verses.en: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
verses.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第五日。

verses.en: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.
verses.zh: 神说：「地要生出活物来，各从其类；牲畜、昆虫、野兽，各从其类。」事就这样成了。

verses.en: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
verses.zh: 于是神造出野兽，各从其类；牲畜，各从其类；地上一切昆虫，各从其类。神看着是好的。

verses.en: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
verses.zh: 神说：「我们要照着我们的形像、按着我们的样式造人，使他们管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟、地上的牲畜，和全地，并地上所爬的一切昆虫。」

words.n: na'aseh — 'let us make'. The plural has been argued over for two thousand years: royal plural, divine council, or something else.

words.g: and + to tread down, i.e. subjugate

verses.en: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
verses.zh: 神就照着自己的形像造人，乃是照着他的形像造男造女。

words.n: b'tsalmo — 'in his image'. tselem + -o ('his'), the same possessive ending you met on elohav in Jonah 1:5.

verses.en: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
verses.zh: 神就赐福给他们，又对他们说：「要生养众多，遍满地面，治理这地，也要管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟，和地上各样行动的活物。」

words.g: and + to tread down, i.e. subjugate

verses.en: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.
verses.zh: 神说：「看哪，我将遍地上一切结种子的菜蔬和一切树上所结有核的果子全赐给你们作食物。

verses.en: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
verses.zh: 至于地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟，并各样爬在地上有生命的物，我将青草赐给它们作食物。」事就这样成了。

verses.en: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
verses.zh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。有晚上，有早晨，是第六日。

verses.en: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.
verses.zh: 天地万物都造齐了。

words.g: and + to end, whether intransitive  or transitived
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar + +them/their

verses.en: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.
verses.zh: 到第七日，神造物的工已经完毕，就在第七日歇了他一切的工，安息了。

words.g: and + to end, whether intransitive  or transitived
and + to repose, i.e. desist from exertion

verses.en: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.
verses.zh: 神赐福给第七日，定为圣日；因为在这日，神歇了他一切创造的工，就安息了。

words.g: to repose, i.e. desist from exertion

verses.en: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.
verses.zh: 创造天地的来历，在耶和华神造天地的日子，乃是这样，

verses.en: No plant of the field was yet on the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,
verses.zh: 野地还没有草木，田间的菜蔬还没有长起来；因为耶和华神还没有降雨在地上，也没有人耕地，

verses.en: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.
verses.zh: 但有雾气从地上腾，滋润遍地。

words.g: and + to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to

verses.en: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.zh: 耶和华神用地上的尘土造人，将生气吹在他鼻孔里，他就成了有灵的活人，名叫亚当。

words.g: and + to mould into a form
and + to puff, in various applications

verses.en: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verses.zh: 耶和华神在东方的伊甸立了一个园子，把所造的人安置在那里。

words.g: and + to strike in, i.e. fix
in + Eden, the region of Adam's home

verses.en: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.zh: 耶和华神使各样的树从地里长出来，可以悦人的眼目，其上的果子好作食物。园子当中又有生命树和分别善恶的树。

verses.en: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.
verses.zh: 有河从伊甸流出来，滋润那园子，从那里分为四道：

words.g: from + Eden, the region of Adam's home
to + to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to
to break through, i.e. spread or separate

verses.en: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
verses.zh: 第一道名叫比逊，就是环绕哈腓拉全地的。在那里有金子，

words.g: the + Chavilah, the name of two or three eastern regions

verses.en: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.
verses.zh: 并且那地的金子是好的；在那里又有珍珠和红玛瑙。

words.g: the + something in pieces, i.e. bdellium
the + a gem, probably the beryl

verses.en: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.
verses.zh: 第二道河名叫基训，就是环绕古实全地的。

words.g: Cush , the name of a son of Ham

verses.en: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
verses.zh: 第三道河名叫底格里斯，流在亚述的东边。第四道河就是幼发拉底河。

words.g: Ashshur, the second son of Shem
Perath , a river of the East

verses.en: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
verses.zh: 耶和华神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理，看守。

words.g: Eden, the region of Adam's home

verses.en: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;
verses.zh: 耶和华神吩咐他说：「园中各样树上的果子，你可以随意吃，

verses.en: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
verses.zh: 只是分别善恶树上的果子，你不可吃，因为你吃的日子必定死！」

verses.en: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
verses.zh: 耶和华神说：「那人独居不好，我要为他造一个配偶帮助他。」

verses.en: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.
verses.zh: 耶和华神用土所造成的野地各样走兽和空中各样飞鸟都带到那人面前，看他叫甚么。那人怎样叫各样的活物，那就是它的名字。

words.g: and + to mould into a form

verses.en: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.
verses.zh: 那人便给一切牲畜和空中飞鸟、野地走兽都起了名；只是那人没有遇见配偶帮助他。

verses.en: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
verses.zh: 耶和华神使他沉睡，他就睡了；于是取下他的一条肋骨，又把肉合起来。

words.g: from + a rib , literally  or figuratively + +him/his/it

verses.en: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
verses.zh: 耶和华神就用那人身上所取的肋骨造成一个女人，领她到那人跟前。

words.g: the + a rib , literally  or figuratively

verses.en: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”
verses.zh: 那人说：这是我骨中的骨，肉中的肉，可以称她为「女人」，因为她是从「男人」身上取出来的。

words.g: the + a stroke, literally or figuratively

verses.en: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
verses.zh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it
and + to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere

verses.en: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
verses.zh: 当时夫妻二人赤身露体，并不羞耻。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”
verses.zh: 耶和华神所造的，惟有蛇比田野一切的活物更狡猾。蛇对女人说：「神岂是真说不许你们吃园中所有树上的果子吗？」

verses.en: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
verses.zh: 女人对蛇说：「园中树上的果子，我们可以吃，

verses.en: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”
verses.zh: 惟有园当中那棵树上的果子，神曾说：『你们不可吃，也不可摸，免得你们死。』」

verses.en: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,
verses.zh: 蛇对女人说：「你们不一定死；

verses.en: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
verses.zh: 因为神知道，你们吃的日子眼睛就明亮了，你们便如神能知道善恶。」

verses.en: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.
verses.zh: 于是女人见那棵树的果子好作食物，也悦人的眼目，且是可喜爱的，能使人有智慧，就摘下果子来吃了，又给她丈夫，她丈夫也吃了。

words.g: to + to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.
verses.zh: 他们二人的眼睛就明亮了，才知道自己是赤身露体，便拿无花果树的叶子为自己编做裙子。

verses.en: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
verses.zh: 天起了凉风，耶和华神在园中行走。那人和他妻子听见神的声音，就藏在园里的树木中，躲避耶和华神的面。

verses.en: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”
verses.zh: 耶和华神呼唤那人，对他说：「你在哪里？」

verses.en: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
verses.zh: 他说：「我在园中听见你的声音，我就害怕；因为我赤身露体，我便藏了。」

verses.en: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
verses.zh: 耶和华说：「谁告诉你赤身露体呢？莫非你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子吗？」

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to + a failure of, i.e.  not

verses.en: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
verses.zh: 那人说：「你所赐给我、与我同居的女人，她把那树上的果子给我，我就吃了。」

verses.en: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
verses.zh: 耶和华神对女人说：「你做的是甚么事呢？」女人说：「那蛇引诱我，我就吃了。」

words.g: to lead astray, i.e.  to delude + +me/my

verses.en: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.
verses.zh: 耶和华神对蛇说：你既做了这事，就必受咒诅，比一切的牲畜野兽更甚；你必用肚子行走，终身吃土。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”
verses.zh: 我又要叫你和女人彼此为仇；你的后裔和女人的后裔也彼此为仇。女人的后裔要伤你的头；你要伤他的脚跟。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
verses.zh: 又对女人说：我必多多加增你怀胎的苦楚；你生产儿女必多受苦楚。你必恋慕你丈夫；你丈夫必管辖你。

verses.en: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.
verses.zh: 又对亚当说：你既听从妻子的话，吃了我所吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子，地必为你的缘故受咒诅；你必终身劳苦才能从地里得吃的。

words.g: and + to + Adam the name of the first man, also of a place in Palestine
in + worrisomeness, i.e. labor or pain

verses.en: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.
verses.zh: 地必给你长出荆棘和蒺藜来；你也要吃田间的菜蔬。

verses.en: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”
verses.zh: 你必汗流满面才得糊口，直到你归了土，因为你是从土而出的。你本是尘土，仍要归于尘土。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.
verses.zh: 亚当给他妻子起名叫夏娃，因为她是众生之母。

verses.en: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
verses.zh: 耶和华神为亚当和他妻子用皮子做衣服给他们穿。

verses.en: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”
verses.zh: 耶和华神说：「那人已经与我们相似，能知道善恶；现在恐怕他伸手又摘生命树的果子吃，就永远活着。」

verses.en: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.
verses.zh: 耶和华神便打发他出伊甸园去，耕种他所自出之土。

words.g: Eden, the region of Adam's home

verses.en: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.zh: 于是把他赶出去了；又在伊甸园的东边安设基路伯和四面转动发火焰的剑，要把守生命树的道路。

words.g: and + to reside or permanently stay
